SAVE THIS ‼️ Easy Healthier Cream Cheese Chicken (only 20 minutes!) 🥰

Announcements:
✅ Want to lose weight without eating boring food? My digital cookbooks include 180+ high-protein recipes with calories and macros included! Grab yours today on my site! 😊
✅ OR Comment “cookbook” and I’ll send you the link! (Macros and Calories Included) 💪🏽
✅ I developed new seasonings for everyday cooking! @spicexseasoning OUT now! 👀

Macros per serving Rice NOT included (makes x2): 410 Calories | 56g P | 2g C | 19g F

For the Chicken:
1lb Chicken Breasts
2 tsp Daily Blend (SPG) 
1 tsp smoked paprika Powder, 
1 tsp SpiceX Bella Blend (dried herbs)
2 teaspoon Butter
2 teaspoon Olive Oil

For the sauce:
2 Shallots, finely diced
3/4 cup Chicken Stock
4 tbsp light Cream Cheese
1 heap tsp Dijon mustard
Resting juices of the chicken 🐓 
finely diced Fresh Chives, to serve

ENJOY 🥰
